name: Emote Bar
summary: Wave, cheer or dance with a single click from a small bar that holds the emotes you use the most.
logoPrompt: A small wooden signboard with a row of round glossy buttons, each showing a simple smiling face in a different warm colour

cover.tagline: Your favourite emotes, one click away.
bullets: Add any emote of the game

description: **Emote Bar puts the emotes you use the most on a small bar, so a wave, a thank you or a dance is one click away.**
- Up to 12 buttons, each runs one emote at your target.
- Starts with wave, hello, thank, cheer, dance and laugh.
- Add any emote the game knows, typed the way you type it in chat.
- Drag the bar anywhere and lock it in place.
- Your emotes and the position are saved for your whole account.
Type `/emotebar add bow` to add a button and `/emotebar remove bow` (or its number) to take it away. `/emotebar` shows or hides the bar, `/emotebar lock` locks it. `/eb` is the short form.
- Works on Retail, in and out of combat.
- Emote commands in your client's language work, the English ones too.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
